summary: Architectural implementation plan for elevating the Dreamlight Welfare Society portal to an authentic, human-crafted institutional non-profit standard. Configures the official UPI ID dreamlightwelfaresociety@ybl across all payment pathways, replaces generic AI aesthetics with warm editorial typography and zero-pill layout discipline, and ensures 100% working interactive modules for donations, tax receipts, volunteer ID card generation, and event RSVPs.
